title: First Production Change
content: New engineers should begin with a small, reversible production change. Create a branch, add or update automated tests, open a pull request, obtain at least one approval, and verify CI passes before merge. Production-impacting changes should include a rollback plan.

title: Architecture Overview
content: The example platform uses a FastAPI service layer, PostgreSQL for durable application data, Redis for short-lived caching, and asynchronous workers for long-running jobs. External AI providers must be accessed through the provider abstraction rather than directly from route handlers.

title: Code Review Expectations
content: Pull requests should explain the problem, implementation approach, test coverage, operational risk, and rollback strategy. Reviewers should focus on correctness, maintainability, security, observability, and whether the change is appropriately scoped.

title: Incident Escalation
content: If a production issue affects customers, notify the incident channel, identify an incident lead, document impact, and prioritize mitigation before root-cause analysis. Avoid speculative status updates; communicate verified facts and next actions.
